question: Does missing-record task bundle size affect recovery?
design: Same task, same 12 evidence rows, only the candidate count per task changes.

bundled.note: invalid on attempt 1, all-unresolved on attempt 2

split.note: recovered FVIII activity 3.3, which is GO-007

implication: Bundle size, not evidence coverage, was blocking recovery. The gold sentence for GO-007 was present in the bundled task all along.
